reviewed_sources.title: Motional Casimir force
reviewed_sources.authors: Marc Thierry Jaekel and Serge Reynaud
reviewed_sources.read_scope: Introduction; motional-force section equations (18)-(19); appendix B moving-scattering and secular Hamiltonian derivation. Other detailed scattering algebra and cited proof dependencies are not newly completed.
reviewed_sources.comparison: Boundary-force coupling and scattering response are prior work. Its reflecting-cavity formula is not a transmitting wormhole-mouth result.

reviewed_sources.title: Fluctuations and dissipation for a mirror in vacuum
reviewed_sources.authors: Marc Thierry Jaekel and Serge Reynaud
reviewed_sources.read_scope: Introduction; fluctuation-dissipation section equations (30)-(32), squeezing discussion, and appendix A retarded/advanced response and dispersion relation. High-frequency transparency is an explicit model assumption. Not a complete new proof-chain review.
reviewed_sources.comparison: Displacement-pressure response and its ultraviolet model dependence are established; it does not determine the covariant mouth inertia here.

reused_dependencies: Moosavi CFT stress transformation and the two-chirality spectrum, Gaussian collars and Weyl anomaly were reviewed in the earlier collar/source records. Proper-cut kinematics and transparent-ray response are rederived product/JT model dependencies. No new complete reading of those sources is claimed.
unused_leads: Haro/Elizalde dynamical-Casimir work and finite-cutoff JT search results were discovery leads only; no conclusions are imported from their snippets.
access_notes: Browser unversioned PDF endpoints identify v1; exact v1 PDF bytes were separately downloaded and hashed. The search for the word subtraction in the single-mirror PDF had no match; the sharp-limit subtraction theorem here is proved directly, not attributed to that paper.
The central literature register has incoming changes and remains untouched.
novelty_assessment: Continue physical long-return damping as provisional primary and matched finite-duration transfer as fallback. Pulling back the proper moving mouth gives the on-shell vertex H_th+(epsilon/b)[T_zz(A)+T_zz(-A)]. The free sharp-pressure spectral response has local inertia -c r^2 w^2/(12 pi^(3/2) h); static subtraction alone is insufficient. A specified Gaussian smoothing h comparable to epsilon gives a return-uniform correction o(q delta). Physical local matching, interacting pressure response, coupled state/exterior and consequential novelty remain unresolved.
development_notes: The initial full check passed. Review added an independent free-vacuum ground-energy derivative/sign identity; the final full check also passed. No tolerance was weakened or failure hidden.
